    READ THE SCOPE

    Same study, another view.

    This dashboard is the visualization layer of the retail SQL case study. It uses the same historical dataset and cleaning rules. The implementation was developed with AI assistance.

    Country and month controls apply to KPIs, monthly values, and product rankings. Market context compares all countries for that period. The CSV export records those scopes explicitly.

    CHECK THE ASSUMPTIONS

    Policies remain visible.

    Remove 5,268 exact repeats under a stated policy. Exclude 2,512 nonpositive-price lines after deduplication. Keep signed credits and missing customer IDs in totals. Calculate extended amounts in integer pence.

    The base analysis passes 14 reconciliation checks. This dashboard adds complete product aggregation and filter checks. Repeated rows could be legitimate; the source study reports the alternative total. Credits are not matched to originating sales or proven cash refunds.

    Source: Chen, D. (2015), UCI Online Retail (opens in a new tab), DOI 10.24432/C5BW33 (opens in a new tab). CC BY 4.0 (opens in a new tab). Aggregation and filtering modify the original data.
